prompt_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one square game card inventory icon for Rootward, a programming fantasy roguelite. Subject: {subject} Style: crisp hand-pixeled 32-bit fantasy RPG inventory art, chunky visible pixel clusters as if designed on a 64 by 64 grid, rich bronze and jewel tones, restrained highlights, strong readable silhouette, slight top-down view. Centered single object occupies 80 percent of canvas. Transparent background, no environment, no border, no lettering, no numbers, no UI, no watermark. Match vintage arcane artifact icons: bronze machinery, violet magic, teal crystals. Output square image.

assets.subject: An ember-orange faceted crystal locked inside a bronze hexagonal cage, a tiny steady flame trapped at its heart, a physical constant of fire.
A pale cyan faceted ice crystal locked inside a bronze hexagonal cage, sharp symmetrical snowflake veins and a cold blue heart, a physical constant of frost.
A golden amber faceted crystal locked inside a bronze hexagonal cage, a crisp little zigzag spark trapped at its heart, a physical constant of lightning.

A bronze sorting tray with three compartments. Similar red crystals gather together in one, blue in another, violet in another, with one larger gem formed from several smaller fragments. A magical collection and grouping device.
A compact enchanted bronze arithmetic mechanism with an unmistakable large plus-shaped golden crystal in its center, a small lavender bolt on each side being strengthened by passing through it.
Two matching lavender crystals, the one on the right half as large, connected by a looping bronze copying mechanism. Magical duplication, large original and smaller echo.

A brass rectangular lens gliding along a short row of five cyan crystals, enclosing exactly three adjacent crystals in one luminous window. A magical sliding inspection window, compact connected device.
Three small adjacent red crystals being fused into a single larger red crystal through a bronze compression clasp, with a separate untouched blue gem next to it. Run length compression made physical.

A bronze two-channel sorting gate separating a short line of bright crystals into two neat queues: large gold attack crystals above and small dim teal crystals below. Order within each queue is preserved.
One violet energy crystal splitting into a sharp orange attack arrowhead and a rounded cyan shield-shaped gem, linked by interlocking bronze zipper teeth. Equal attack and defense.
Three small bronze target rings with glowing amber crystal centers linked in sequence by two crisp zigzag golden sparks, clearly one lightning chain through three targets.
A bronze-framed violet magic mirror with three nested smaller mirror reflections and a row of small lavender crystals reflected in reverse order. Compact magical recursion artifact.

One violet crystal at the bottom branching through a bronze Y-shaped channel into two identical violet crystals at the top. Arcane duplication of spell bolts. This is a programming fork, never table cutlery.
A small open antique bronze-bound spellbook conjuring exactly two floating lavender quills or feather-shaped crystals above its pages. A spell that creates two smaller spells. No modern electronics.
